sources.title: Beijing Normal University 2027 Admission Brochure for Undergraduate Credit Program (Chinese-taught)

name.en: Chinese-taught Undergraduate Credit Program (General Advanced Studies Student)
name.zh: 中文授课本科学分项目（普通进修生）

durationText.en: one semester or one academic year

languageRequirements.minimum: TCSOL: HSK Level 4 total 180 or above; other majors: HSK Level 5 total 180 or above. Applicants with prior/current academic qualifications taught in Chinese are exempt from submitting HSK score reports.

qualification.en: Non-degree undergraduate credit study as a general advanced studies student; this record does not offer a bachelor’s degree.
qualification.zh: 以普通进修生身份修读本科学分的非学历项目，本记录不代表本科学位招生。

languagePolicy.en: Chinese-taught credit program. Admission language requirements depend on the intended major; prior/current Chinese-taught academic qualification evidence can exempt HSK submission.
languagePolicy.zh: 中文授课学分项目，语言门槛按拟申请专业区分；中文授课学历证明可用于HSK材料豁免。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizens aged 18–45 with a valid foreign passport, in good health and of good character; respect Chinese habits and customs and comply with Chinese law and university regulations.
eligibility.zh: 18–45周岁、持有效外国护照的非中国籍公民，身体健康、品行良好，尊重中国风俗习惯并遵守中国法律及学校规章。

eligibility.en: Second year of university or above; applicants take undergraduate courses as general advanced studies students.
eligibility.zh: 大学二年级（含）以上，以普通进修生身份修读本科课程。

eligibility.en: TCSOL requires HSK Level 4 with at least 180; other majors require HSK Level 5 with at least 180. Prior/current Chinese-taught academic qualifications can exempt the applicant from submitting HSK results.
eligibility.zh: 汉语国际教育专业要求HSK4级180分及以上，其他专业要求HSK5级180分及以上；已取得或正在修读中文授课学历的申请人可免交HSK成绩。

applicationMaterials.en: Complete the BNU International Students Application Form online; after preliminary approval, download, print and sign the system-generated form and send its scanned signed copy to the university according to its instructions.
applicationMaterials.zh: 在线填写北师大国际学生申请表；初审通过后下载、打印并签署系统生成的申请表，按学校说明提交签字扫描件。

applicationMaterials.en: Passport bio page and the recent Chinese visa page if applicable; final degree certificate or certificate of enrollment; transcript of the final academic study period.
applicationMaterials.zh: 护照个人信息页，有中国签证者另交最近签证页；最高学历证书或在读证明；最后一段学历学习的成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: HSK certificate and transcript, or an institutional certificate that the prior/current academic degree is taught in Chinese; a recommendation letter signed by a teacher.
applicationMaterials.zh: HSK证书及成绩单，或学校出具的已取得/正在修读学历为中文授课的证明；一封教师签字推荐信。

applicationMaterials.en: Non-criminal record (exchange students are exempt). Pay the CNY450 non-refundable application fee online; agreement-based exchange students may receive a waiver.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无犯罪记录证明（交换生免交）；在线缴纳450元不退还的申请费，符合相关协议的交换生可免交。

applicationMaterials.en: All documents must be in Chinese or English; documents in other languages need notarized Chinese/English translations. Applicants studying at a higher education institution in China during application, if admitted, must provide that institution’s completion or graduation certificate at registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 材料须为中文或英文，其他语种须提供经公证的中文或英文翻译件。申请期间在中国高校学习者，获录取后须于报到时提供该校结业或毕业证明。

tuitionSchedule.en: Liberal Arts: CNY11,600 per semester or CNY22,400 per academic year. Science, Engineering, Arts and P.E.: CNY13,050 per semester or CNY25,300 per academic year. The numeric semester fee is the Liberal Arts rate; it does not apply to every subject group.
tuitionSchedule.zh: 文科：11600元/学期或22400元/学年；理工艺体：13050元/学期或25300元/学年。数值学期费用为文科标准，并非全部学科统一收费。

notes.en: The official page body explicitly offers March 2027 entry with applications from 10 October to 15 December 2026. December 20 is only the re-submission deadline when the university requests supplementary materials. The page retains a 2020 publication stamp and a closed autumn 2026 section; neither is rolled forward. Its linked majors catalogue is labelled 2026, so this is the named non-degree credit route, without certifying a new 2027 list of individual majors. Fees vary by subject group and study length; the displayed numeric amount is the Liberal Arts semester rate. No scholarship or admission is promised. The fresh official brochure supplies the HTTPS application URL; the portal was not independently fetched or its login tested in this recovery batch.
notes.zh: 官方正文明确2027年3月入学、2026年10月10日至12月15日申请；12月20日仅为学校要求补件后的再次提交期限。页面保留2020发布时间及已关闭的2026秋季条目，均未滚动推算。其专业目录链接仍标2026年，本记录仅确认所述非学历学分项目，不认证新的2027具体专业清单。学费按学科及修读期限区分，数值为文科学期标准。不承诺奖学金或录取。HTTPS申请链接来自本次新抓取的官方简章；本恢复批次未独立抓取门户或验证其登录。

evidence.derivation: Undergraduate credit study is non-degree general advanced study; it is not bachelor-degree admission.

evidence.quote: Applicant’s Chinese proficiency must meet the requirements of the majors applied for. A minimum score of 180 or above in the HSK test (Level 4) is required for the major of Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages. A minimum score of 180 or above in the HSK test (Level 5) is required for other majors. Applicants with prior/current academic qualifications taught in Chinese are exempt from submitting HSK score reports.
evidence.locator: I. Application Requirements item 4, both HSK thresholds and exemption

evidence.quote: I. Application Requirements 1. Applicants should be in good health and of good character, respect Chinese habits and customs, and abide by both Chinese Law & Regulations as well as the university’s Rules & Regulations. 2. Non-Chinese citizens aged between 18 and 45 with a valid foreign passport. 3. Second year of college (including) or above. 4. Applicant’s Chinese proficiency must meet the requirements of the majors applied for. A minimum score of 180 or above in the HSK test (Level 4) is required for the major of Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages. A minimum score of 180 or above in the HSK test (Level 5) is required for other majors. Applicants with prior/current academic qualifications taught in Chinese are exempt from submitting HSK score reports. II. Application Period

IV. Application Documents 1. Beijing Normal University International Students Application Form. Please log on to the Beijing Normal University International Student Online Application System (https://international.bnu.edu.cn/) and fill in the form online. 2. Passport Bio Page. Applicants who have a Chinese visa must provide the recent visa page. 3. Final Degree Certificate or Certificate of Enrollment. 4. Transcript of the final academic study period. 5. HSK certificate and transcript; Or the certificate issued by the institution that the prior/current academic degree is taught in Chinese. 6. A letter of recommendation from a teacher. The letter of recommendation has no fixed format, but it must be signed by the teacher. 7. Non-criminal Record. Exchange students are not required to submit. 8. Application fee of RMB 450. Please pay online through a personal account on Beijing Normal University International Student Online Application System (https://international.bnu.edu.cn/). Application fees can be waived for exchange students according to the relevant agreement. * All application documents must be in Chinese or English. Please provide the notarized version of documents translated to Chinese or English from other languages. * The application fee is non-refundable. It will not be returned regardless of whether the applicant is admitted by the institution. * Applicants studying at a higher education institution in China during the application period, if admitted, must provide a completion or graduation certificate issued by that institution upon registration. V. List of Enrollment Majors
